title: The Novena to Our Mother of Perpetual Help

steps.title: Sign of the Cross
steps.versicle: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

steps.title: Novena Intention
steps.prompt: Lay before Our Mother of Perpetual Help the necessities you carry, and trust her never-failing help.

steps.title: Versicle and response
steps.versicle: Pray for us, O Mother of Perpetual Help:
steps.response: That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

sub_tuum_praesidium.text:
We fly to your protection,
O holy Mother of God.
Despise not our petitions in our necessities,
but deliver us always from all dangers,
O glorious and blessed Virgin.
Amen.
sub_tuum_praesidium.latin:
Sub tuum praesidium confugimus,
sancta Dei Genetrix.
Nostras deprecationes ne despicias in necessitatibus,
sed a periculis cunctis libera nos semper,
Virgo gloriosa et benedicta.
Amen.

hail_mary.text:
Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee.
Blessed art thou among women,
and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.
Holy Mary, Mother of God,
pray for us sinners,
now and at the hour of our death.
Amen.
hail_mary.latin:
Ave Maria, gratia plena, Dominus tecum.
Benedicta tu in mulieribus,
et benedictus fructus ventris tui, Iesus.
Sancta Maria, Mater Dei,
ora pro nobis peccatoribus,
nunc et in hora mortis nostrae.
Amen.

memorare.text:
Remember, O most gracious Virgin Mary,
that never was it known that anyone who fled to thy protection,
implored thy help, or sought thy intercession,
was left unaided.
Inspired by this confidence,
I fly unto thee, O Virgin of virgins, my Mother.
To thee do I come, before thee I stand, sinful and sorrowful.
O Mother of the Word Incarnate,
despise not my petitions,
but in thy mercy, hear and answer me.
Amen.
memorare.latin:
Memorare, O piissima Virgo Maria,
non esse auditum a saeculo,
quemquam ad tua currentem praesidia,
tua implorantem auxilia,
tua petentem suffragia, esse derelictum.
Ego tali animatus confidentia,
ad te, Virgo Virginum, Mater, curro,
ad te venio, coram te gemens peccator assisto.
Noli, Mater Verbi, verba mea despicere;
sed audi propitia et exaudi.
Amen.

schedule_note.note: The weekly novena to Our Mother of Perpetual Help: due Tuesdays per the brief's pinned weekday (the tradition's Tuesday novena devotions). The session is a single static session built from public-domain and ancient-attribution formulas plus the title invocation, in preference to the Redemptorists' copyrighted novena booklet.
